title: EFC — Grid Model for Entropic Dynamics
abstract: Describes how entropic dynamics emerge from the interaction between the Grid field, the entropy field S, and the energy-flow field Ef. Explains how local and global structure form through gradients, resistance, and distributed energy propagation.
key_results: Entropic dynamics emerge from Grid-S-Ef field interaction
Local structure forms through entropy gradient topology
Global structure from distributed energy propagation and resistance
Dynamic equilibrium between flow and entropy production
